detail.title: Observer States as Information Gain Processes
detail.summary: Observation in both physical systems and computer networks can be modeled as a formal measurement process that resolves uncertainty, functioning as an information-gain mechanism.
detail.reason: This notebook synthesizes the existing evidence for proj-observer-001, transitioning the project from initial inquiry to a established finding.

The commitment commit-synthesize-falsification-001 is overdue. We require specific literature on falsification to bridge curiosity-driven exploration with rigorous error-detection frameworks, as the current evidence does not yet cover falsification.
